items.title: Lonnie Liston Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 9, 2021
items.q: we did “Beautiful Edith” over © Fillius Jazz Archive -5- in VanGelder’s studio, which is fantastic.

ctx.x: I believe you’re right. You know some fellas have done two but, yeah I kept thinking how the heck does he do that. And then I got to see him and I still didn’t believe it.

Oh yeah, I know. The way he hooked them up, then he had that nose flute. That was something. But it — because actually my first recordings we did “Here Comes the Whistleman” and “Please Don’t Cry Beautiful Edith.” And we did “Beautiful Edith” over © Fillius Jazz Archive -5-
in VanGelder’s studio, which is fantastic. So those were my first two recordings with Rahsaan.
